hypothesis: Author/component context can correct some global risk miscalibration, while shrinkage limits sparse-context overfit
fixed: Same 3088 labels, 46 numeric features, numeric combined logistic regularization0.1, source-isolated 9 validation cells, character grouping, threshold0.8, D/M/source trajectories and evaluation cohorts
context: Public component canonical|variant|role|parent-layout|stroke-count; use exact same component_key as donor compatibility. No target capture features.
offset: Freeze numeric model fit on each training cell. Fit penalized additive logit offsets using author, component, or author+component+author/component indicator blocks. Equal weight per writer-character. No independent unpenalized group intercept. Vocabulary only from training; unseen categories contribute zero. Query character excluded across authors before numeric fitting and vocabulary.
selection: Compare 9 offsets plus exact numeric base on pooled character-balanced source-isolated out-of-fold Brier; ties logloss then base then author then component then hierarchical then stronger regularization. Freeze before querying development/regression. No threshold retuning.
audit: Before fitting report all numeric-model false accepts and failure flags, exact-context support from their own training cell, relative/local/angle harms. Do not redefine safe labels or remove difficult groups.
limits: Repeated model selection on observed training folds is exploratory. Categorical offsets encode context priors, not naturalness or causal correction. Previously observed regression and crossfit/full-profile shift remain. Production unchanged.
